info.title: PowerForge.Web CLI
info.description: PowerForge.Web command-line interface for building and serving static sites.

options.name: --from
options.description:
powerforge-web observe import --input <observations.json> --database <search.db> [--provider <id>] [--site <id>] [--output json]
powerforge-web observe import-bing --config <search-providers.json> --input <export.csv> --database <search.db>
powerforge-web traffic list --database <search.db> --site <id> --provider <id> [--from <yyyy-MM-dd>] [--to <yyyy-MM-dd>] [--output json]
powerforge-web performance import-lighthouse --config <search-providers.json> --input <report.json> --database <search.db>

options.name: --site
options.description:
[--search-type <type>] [--evidence <reference>] [--output json]
powerforge-web opportunity list --database <search.db> --site <id> [--provider <id>] [--from <yyyy-MM-dd>] [--to <yyyy-MM-dd>]
